text: Cycling is a fun and healthy way to get around. To protect yourself from injuries, a helmet is essential. A helmet can also help you avoid getting hurt in case of a crash. The gear you wear can also help you ride faster and more safely. Some cyclists use pedals to help them pedal with more power, and others use a more traditional gear system. Both systems have their advantages and disadvantages, but it's important to choose the one that works best for you.
